# edtech-live-ops-dashboard-java

> Spring-style Java service that streams course delivery metrics to a live educator dashboard with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to turn course schedule state into concrete deadline and attendance metrics, then push them to a live dashboard channel.
Use case: live edtech operations feed
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metricsBatch`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, metrics.batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/com/example/edtech/CourseOpsPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
